b: I’ve spent decades leading technology businesses, and I’m finding that agentic AI has changed how I operate as an executive.
I increasingly use AI agents to oversee key business functions, analyze performance, and identify issues that deserve closer attention.

What surprises me most is how much easier it has become to dive into functional details analyzing sales funnels, sifting through P&Ls or reviewing operations. Questions that previously required several meetings, reports, and management discussions can now be explored in minutes.
I suspect we’re only beginning to understand how AI will change leadership, management structures, and decision-making. I am curious how others are experiencing this.
Are you using agentic AI to change how you manage or lead? What are you doing differently, and what has actually worked? I’d love to hear concrete examples.
